description: Bebat - points de collecte de piles et batteries is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by BEBAT. Trouver un point de collecte près de chez vous: Dans le jeu de données vous trouverez les coordonnées géographiques ainsi que le nom du site de collecte. The 2 datasets in this record: Bebat - Points de collecte; Bebat, Points de collecte de piles et batteries. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are pile, collecte. The portal shows 9,548 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
